notes.title: ◆Large edition trial version and Ver1.2.2 update!
notes.notes:
We have received a lot of feedback from people who have played Tokyo Game Dungeon, saying, ``It's fun to actually play!'', so we've prepared a large•scale trial version!
The only character you can use is RUI·K, but you can play all three stages!

Additionally, we have updated the product version to improve the UX and fixed bugs based on the feedback we received.
Enjoy RGS, which has become easier to play!
[Modification details]
· Added option to swap 〇×(AB) buttons
·Improved reroll UI
·Improved magnet function
·Increase the number of rankings displayed
·Fixed so that pipo that was not displayed in some resolutions is displayed.
·Other minor bug fixes
┗As a result of bug fixes, it is now easier to level up than before.
*Please forgive me for using automatic translation for announcements as we are a small team.

notes.title: Ver1.1.0 Rogue Addition Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We've released the Rogue addition update!

The winning character [MUKOMON] from the SpeedRun event held during SteamNextFest has arrived!
Take on SpeedRun challenges with this new character, who dashes across the field while throwing wrenches!

Rogue Introduction:
MUKOMON works hard every day with safety first. His partner is a monkey wrench!
He possesses a Special Skill that transforms his weapon into a giant monkey wrench that he throws at enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108572/2a2785904236faace01f3ec611d3f5ff707b18e4.png

We are thrilled that so many people played the demo at SteamNextFest!
Now, we’d like to introduce the top three players with the best times!

1st 1:30.41 伝説の巨人むこもん 
2st 1:43.02 sio
3st  2:07.04 くらげ茶ぷりん

Congratulations!

In the next Ver1.2.0 update, we plan to implement a World Ranking that lets you compete with users worldwide.
Sharpen your skills and get ready to aim for the top global rank!
*Note: Personal best times will be reset in the Ver1.2.0 update.
Permanent upgrades and achievements will not be reset.

notes.title: Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Rogue Gladius Survivors is now on sale today!

◆RGS goes to SpeedRun Survivors-like!
Based on the response from the beta test and Next Fest, RGS has been reborn as a time attack survivor-like game where you compete for the fastest time.
The product version has three unique stages optimized for time attack.

The number of monsters that appear has increased significantly, raising the overall difficulty level, and new items have been added that can cause monster waves at any time, making it a very challenging and playful place to play.

In addition, to commemorate the start of sales, we are running a campaign where you can purchase at 20% off for 14 days after release.
Please take this opportunity to enjoy RGS, which has evolved further as a time attack exclusive survivor!

*Please forgive me for using automatic translation for announcements as we are a small team.

notes.title: Regarding bugs in the Next Fest limited trial version
notes.notes:
We have fixed the following bugs in the Steam Next Fest limited trial version.

1. Freezes if you press a certain key repeatedly when entering the stage
2. Unexpected behavior occurs when defeating a boss from outside the boss area
3. If the final boss appears while checking the skill acquisition screen that appears from the third boss's treasure chest, unexpected behavior occurs.

*Bug reports are accepted on the bulletin board.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2804020/discussions/

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
Please continue to support Rogue Gladius Survivors.
